title: Villa Sumalee
shortDescription: Villa Sumalee is a small completed complex of two-storey townhouses in Rawai, southern Phuket, built in 2017.
description: Villa Sumalee is a small completed complex of two-storey townhouses in Rawai, southern Phuket, built in 2017. The roughly 144 sqm homes have two bedrooms and three bathrooms and share a communal pool.
